name: moji-pro
description: Adds visual symbols to your coding keywords for enhanced memorability and comprehension.

commands.title: Moji Pro: Toggle Code Block Highlighting

mojiPro.enabled.description: Enable or disable emoji keyword decorations.

enumDescriptions: Hide keyword text and show only the emoji.
Dim keyword text and show the emoji before it.
mojiPro.displayMode.description: How emojis are rendered relative to keywords.

mojiPro.overlayOpacity.description: Opacity of keyword text in overlay mode (0 = invisible, 1 = fully visible).

mojiPro.codeBlocks.enabled.description: Enable code block highlighting — applies a subtle background tint to each detected code block.

mojiPro.codeBlocks.backgroundColor.description: CSS color for the block background tint. Accepts any valid CSS color string (e.g. rgba, hex, named colors).

mojiPro.htmlTags.description: Master toggle: show emojis for HTML tag names.

mojiPro.htmlVoidElements.description: Master toggle: show emojis for HTML void elements.

mojiPro.htmlAttributes.description: Master toggle: show emojis for HTML attribute names.

mojiPro.javascriptKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for JavaScript keywords.

mojiPro.cssAtRules.description: Master toggle: show emojis for CSS at-rules (@media, @keyframes, etc.)

mojiPro.cssLayout.description: Master toggle: show emojis for CSS layout properties.

mojiPro.cssBox.description: Master toggle: show emojis for CSS box model properties.

mojiPro.cssVisual.description: Master toggle: show emojis for CSS visual properties.

mojiPro.cssPseudo.description: Master toggle: show emojis for CSS pseudo-classes.

mojiPro.cssValues.description: Master toggle: show emojis for CSS important values.

mojiPro.pythonKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for Python keywords.

mojiPro.cKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for C keywords.

mojiPro.cppKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for C++ keywords.

mojiPro.csharpKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for C# keywords.

mojiPro.sqlKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for SQL keywords.

mojiPro.typescriptKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for TypeScript keywords.

mojiPro.javaKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for Java keywords.
